alarm.text: The silent alarm went off at a corner market. The clerk is restocking cigarettes. He hit the button with his knee.

success.note: Nothing. A free coffee you're not supposed to take.

robbery.text: Through the front glass: a clerk with his hands up and a man with a gun at the register. He hasn't seen your car yet.

options.text: Take positions outside and wait for him to come out.
Call it in and request backup first.

lift.text: The "robbery" is a skinny kid the clerk has cornered by the beer cooler. The clerk says the kid has a gun in his pocket. The kid says it's his phone.

options.text: Order him to show his hands, slowly.

failure.note: He panics and runs for the door.

lift_hands.text: It's a phone. In his other pocket: two candy bars and a can of baby formula.

options.text: Pay for the formula yourself and warn him.

success.note: The clerk calls you soft. The kid says thank you.
